description: Partner accounts only. Create a news post on the channel (no id) or update one (with id). With published: true it is live on the public channel page at once; without it, it stays a draft.

id.description: Post id from list_channel_posts to update; omit to create.

imageUrl.description: Image URL returned by a channel_news upload.

published.description: true publishes, false keeps a draft.

name: save_channel_post

error.description: Present when the call did not succeed.

reason.description: not_a_partner when the signed-in account has no partner account.

title: Create or edit a news post
